rules.statement: A will clause creating a fidei commissum can still be effective even after an internal distribution among heirs, provided the deed does not alter the original conditions of the will.
rules.supporting_quote: "However imperfect the words of the deed may be as a matter of conveyance, it clearly was intended to effect a division of the various lands of the testatrix among the heirs, but such a deed would not, in my opinion, put an end to the fidei commissum originally created by the will"
